source: Int. J. Mol. Sci. 2025, 26, 9262, Fig. 8 (doi 10.3390/ijms26199262, open access); plot colours from Figs 1, 4 and 7 of the same paper
method: page rendered at 300 dpi; each flat fill is the mode of exact pixel colours (colours quantised to 2 levels to group a fill, the exact most frequent value inside the group is kept); see palette/sample_palette.py
note: Only hex values are shipped. No page image of the paper is part of this repository. Run palette/sample_palette.py on your own paper to get your own set.
